# has accessibility need

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAccessibilityNeed`](gmeow-hasAccessibilityNeed.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAccessibilityNeed>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accessibility`](../../slices/accessibility.md)

Relates an entity to an accessibility facet it requires in order to reach or use a location. Non-functional: needs are co-equal facets ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). There is no 'primary need' — all asserted needs coexist.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:AccessibilityFacet`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityFacet.md)
